dialect: libgda generic SQL parser (GdaSqlParser created with gda_sql_parser_new, no provider-specific parser)
parser_family: libgda Lemon-generated SQL grammar (libgda/sql-parser/parser.y) with GdaSqlParser's hand-written tokenizer; its own family, not shared with SQLite's parse.y or the PostgreSQL grammar
oracle: The replay prints, per statement, the JSON from gda_sql_statement_serialize of the GdaSqlStatement that gda_sql_parser_parse_string built; summarize.py reads stmt_type, SELECT fields, from targets and joins, where, group_by, order_by, function names, INSERT table, fields and values from it, and run-control requires the hand-written oracle summary.
api: gda_init(); gda_sql_parser_new(); gda_sql_parser_parse_string(parser, local NUL-terminated SQL text, &remain, &error) -> GdaStatement; its "structure" property is the GdaSqlStatement tree, serialized with gda_sql_statement_serialize
coverage: LLVM source coverage of the pinned libgda 5.2.10 libgda/sql-parser sources reached by gda_sql_parser_parse_string and gda_sql_statement_serialize (Lemon grammar parser.c, tokenizer gda-sql-parser.c, statement structs); the Lemon outputs are regenerated by the bundled lemon from the pinned parser.y and delimiter.y and their #line directives removed so lines map to the generated C files
scope: SQL statements from local bytes parsed one by one with gda_sql_parser_parse_string by libgda's generic parser (no connection, no provider); valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. Provider-specific parsers, GdaSqlBuilder, rendering and execution are untested.
